name: Legal Agent Benchmark
intro: Legal Agent Benchmark 是 Harvey 持续演进的公开法律智能体基准。固定仓库快照 845a088 的 README 标示 1,671 个任务，覆盖 24 个法律执业领域及合同工作，并已纳入并购尽职调查扩展；同版本评测文档仍保留 1,660 个任务和约 101,000 个评分点的旧口径，因此不声称当前评分点的精确总数。公开任务在隔离沙箱内按全评分点通过计分，独立 LAB-AA 排行榜则使用 120 个未公开留出任务。
build_method: 真实事项抽象与律师任务设计, 合成材料及内容审核, 原子二元评分点, schema/integrity 门禁
metric: All-pass task rate (headline), pooled criterion pass rate (diagnostic)
modality: 文本, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, 邮件
task_type: 法律智能体任务, 文档交付
eval_feature: 隔离工具环境与隐藏评分准则, 按交付物解析, 多供应商逐评分点 LLM 评判, 严格全通过计分
scale: 1,671 个任务（README，845a088）/ 24 个执业领域及合同工作，并含尽调扩展；当前准确评分点总数未发布（同版本旧文档仍写 1,660 / 约 101,000）
modality_en: Text, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, email
build_method_en: Real-matter abstraction and lawyer task design, reviewed synthetic materials, atomic binary criteria, schema/integrity gates
eval_feature_en: Isolated tools and hidden rubrics, deliverable-aware parsing, multi-provider criterion-level LLM judging, strict all-pass scoring
intro_en: Legal Agent Benchmark is Harvey's evolving public benchmark for legal agents. README at pinned repository snapshot 845a088 advertises 1,671 tasks across 24 legal practice areas plus contracting and includes the M&A diligence extension; same-revision evaluation docs retain the older 1,660-task and about 101,000-criterion counts, so no exact current criterion total is claimed. Public tasks use isolated all-pass evaluation, while the separate LAB-AA leaderboard uses 120 unreleased holdout tasks.
scale_en: 1,671 tasks (README at 845a088) / 24 practice areas plus contracting and the diligence extension; exact current criterion total unpublished (same-revision older docs: 1,660 / about 101,000)
metric_en: All-pass task rate (headline), pooled criterion pass rate (diagnostic)

drawio_review_note: No associated research paper was found. This reconstruction uses Harvey's May 6, 2026 announcement (https://www.harvey.ai/blog/introducing-harveys-legal-agent-benchmark), current extension posts, and fixed official repository commit 845a08840869b21a5c11958aae58bf5f00a7b775 (2026-07-17). README at that commit advertises 1,671 tasks across 24 practice areas plus contracting and includes the M&A diligence extension, while same-revision tutorial/evaluation docs still state 1,660 tasks and about 101,000 criteria; the exact current criterion total is therefore not claimed. Practicing-lawyer work is abstracted into roughly 50-word partner-style, closed-universe assignments; synthetic key and peripheral matter files are generated in batches under lawyer guidance and review. Atomic, binary, equal-weight criteria use match_criteria, deliverable scope, and optional source references instead of a gold output. Repository integrity tests check parseable task JSON, nonempty titles, criteria, unique IDs, deliverable lists, and removal of legacy weights for standard tasks. The harness forbids agent access to task.json/rubrics, runs six tools in a network-disabled, capability-dropped Podman sandbox, and defaults to 200 turns. Evaluation resolves deliverable filenames, parses DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF content, and sends only criterion-scoped output to a configurable Anthropic/Google/OpenAI/Mistral judge; default is Claude Sonnet 4.6 at temperature 0 with JSON verdict/reasoning. A task passes only when every criterion passes; pooled criterion rate and operational metrics are diagnostic. The MIT repository is public and no public train/dev/test split was found. has_leaderboard=true refers to the separate Artificial Analysis LAB-AA leaderboard (https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/harvey-lab-aa), which independently evaluates a private 120-task, 24-area holdout with the Stirrup harness and must not be conflated with scores on the public repository tasks.
